challenge.name: Example Forecasting Challenge
challenge.citation: Cayelan C. Carey, Adrienne Breef-Pilz, Austin D. Delany, et al. A real-time, automated ecological monitoring workflow and data publication program to enable daily ecosystem forecasting. ESS Open Archive. 05 November 2026. https://doi.org/10.22541/essoar.15011733/v1

datasets.name: Targets
datasets.about: The observations to forecast. Forecasts are scored against them.

columns.name: duration
columns.text: Time step as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. P1D for a day

datasets.name: Forecasts
datasets.about: Every forecast that passed validation, from every model and baseline, partitioned by duration, model and date.

columns.name: model_id
columns.text: The model that made the forecast

columns.name: family
columns.text: ensemble, sample, or a distribution such as normal

columns.name: parameter
columns.text: Ensemble member number, or the distribution's parameter (mu, sigma)

datasets.name: Forecast summaries
datasets.about: The mean, median, standard deviation and 95% interval of every forecast.

columns.name: model_id
columns.text: The model that made the forecast

datasets.name: Scores
datasets.about: One score per model, site, forecast time and lead time, computed once the observation is available. The leaderboards are built from them.

columns.name: model_id
columns.text: The model that made the forecast

columns.name: crps
columns.text: Continuous ranked probability score; lower is better

datasets.name: Submission results
datasets.about: What the challenge did with each file it read: processed, or invalid with the reason. "Check my submissions" reads this.

columns.name: file
columns.text: The file's path in the model's repository

columns.name: model_id
columns.text: The model named in the file

columns.name: status
columns.text: processed, invalid, skipped, unreadable or failed

columns.name: reason
columns.text: Why a file was refused, when it was

columns.name: first_seen
columns.text: When the challenge first saw this outcome
